prompt: A small underground chamber of rough grey rock, seen in a first-person view at standing eye height, with walls and floor of weathered stone. In the foreground, a small pit opens in the stone floor, with a stairway of rough stone steps leading down into it and wisps of white mist rising out of it. On the right, a passage opening in the grey rock wall leads away, and orange stone in smooth wavy bands is visible through it. On the left, a small crack splits the grey rock wall, a thin dark slit in the stone. A single pool of warm lamplight from just behind the camera lights the middle of the chamber, and the edges of the picture fall into darkness. The picture fills the whole frame, edge to edge. Setting: a medieval fantasy world; everything is old and handmade: weathered stone and old brick, rough timber, wrought iron. Style: 1970s comic book art: bold black ink outlines, hand-inked hatching, flat printed colours with visible halftone dots, slightly off-register colour printing, muted earthy palette of browns, ochres, olive and amber, on aged newsprint. Mood: quiet, still and mysterious, a place long left alone.
